definitions.full: H6061. Anaq I. עֲנָק noun [masculine] neck , only in epithet of people הָעֲנָק בְּנֵי long-necked (tall) men , early giant people about Hebron and in Philistia, Ενακ , Εναχ , Josh 15:14 (JE) = Judg 1:20 , without article Num 13:33 (JE), Deut 9:2 ; also הָע ׳יְלִדַי Num 13:22 , 28 ; Josh 15:14 (all J E); called also עֲנָקִים long-necks , Ενακειμ , 14:12 , 15 (JE), 11:21-22 , (D), Deut 2:10-11 , 21 + Jer 47:5 (read עֲנָקִים for עִמְקָם ᵑ0 ), and perhaps 1Chr 12:16 (see עֵמֶק near the end ); עֲנָקִים בְּנֵי 1:28 ( ᵐ5 γίγαντες , compare Num 13:33 ), 9:2 ; עֲנָק later (erroneously) as eponymous ancestor of Anakim Josh 15:13 = עֲנוֺק 21:11 (both P). — See especially Mey ZAW i (1881), 139 GFM Judg 1:10 . 20 Che Ency. Bib. ANAK .
